captures.assertion: Buyer, registration fiscal year, and the registered-contract count are visible together, and the after-start count reads 405 of 1,155 for Parks in FY2026.
The same buyer, year, and counts remain visible on a wide viewport with no horizontal overflow at any nesting level.
Narrowing to construction services through competitive sealed bidding changes the answer to 5 of 40, and the industry and award-method controls reflect the selected scope.
The after-start action drills through to the scoped list carrying buyer, fiscal year, and comparison; browser Back restores the unfiltered scope and the same count.
Both actions are focusable links that activate from the keyboard and present a touch target of at least 44 CSS pixels.
axe-core reports no serious or critical violation, and no landmark, region, heading-order, or contrast violation, within the buyer history.
At 200% zoom on a narrow viewport the panel reflows without horizontal overflow and keeps the buyer and year visible.

A failed source request keeps the selected buyer and fiscal year, offers a retry of at least 44 CSS pixels, and never renders the buyer as having zero contracts; the retry restores the history without re-choosing anything.
Against the population this site currently publishes, the contract count stays visible while registration timing reads as not measured yet rather than as zero registered after start.
With scripting disabled the panel fabricates no count.
